subject: hacklist board ordering: production versus a learned candidate
claim_state: Implemented, not measured on organic traffic.

honesty.traffic: No organic traffic exists yet. Every number produced before a deploy collects real impressions is synthetic.
honesty.implemented_vs_measured: The logging, the ranker, the interleaving and the evaluator are implemented and exercised locally. Nothing here is a measurement of how people use the board.
honesty.local_vs_deployed: Everything in this manifest was produced locally. The Analytics Engine binding takes effect only on the next deploy of the repo's existing workflow.

production_ordering.description: The board's first paint: default region, default view, no search, sorted by start date ascending with a stable tie-break on the order data/events.json already carries (hackathon before adjacent, then score descending).
production_ordering.called_by: app/board.tsx (the page calls the same function; nothing re-implements the ordering)
production_ordering.as_of_rationale: The board drops events that have already finished, so its list depends on the render instant. Freezing at meta.sweepCompletedAt makes the snapshot reproducible from the committed files alone.

features.rule: Ranking-time only. A feature may read a field the sweep wrote before the list was rendered, or compare against the render instant the impression records. Engagement counts are excluded: a click total is future information relative to the impression that produced it.
excluded_on_purpose: clicks, saves or impressions for the event (future information relative to an impression)
anything derived from the reader beyond the anonymous client id: no IP, no email, no name, no user-agent, no referrer

model.family: logistic regression, binary, predicting click-or-save from the feature vector
model.optimizer: full-batch gradient descent in plain JavaScript, no dependencies
model.regularization: L2 on the weights only, lambda = 0.01

position_bias_correction.status: ASSUMED, NOT MEASURED. Hacklist has no position-swap experiment, so this curve is borrowed rather than fitted.

model.determinism: Full-batch, zero-initialized, fixed step count: the weights are a function of the rows and the hyperparameters, not of row order or a seed.

split.rule: For each evaluation day d, train on every row strictly before the start of day d and evaluate on day d only. No row is ever both trained on and evaluated.

baselines.description: clicks accumulated strictly before the impression instant, descending; ties fall back to production order
seeded shuffle, seed fixed in the evaluator
the trained model's ordering (the thing on trial)

metrics: coverage (distinct events appearing in any top 10)
regional coverage (distinct regions appearing in any top 10)
interval_method: bootstrap, 2000 resamples, resampled by client rather than by row, 95 percent percentile interval

all_of: the leakage detector reports no leakage
all four negative controls behave as expected
the candidate beats the best frozen offline baseline on NDCG@10
the candidate wins the organic team-draft interleaving with a lower 95 percent bootstrap bound above zero
no material diversity or regional-coverage drop: coverage@10 within 10 percent of production, and regional coverage not lower than production

organic_gate.rule: Only rows tagged source=web count. Seeded, synthetic, developer and replay rows never count.

negative_controls.expectation: the leakage detector FAILS the run
negative_controls.mechanism: a feature is added that reads engagement written after the impression; the detector perturbs every event field outside the allow-list and the feature vector moves
labels are shuffled within the training window, so the model has nothing to learn

negative_controls.expectation: a client with no history receives EXACTLY the production ordering
negative_controls.mechanism: no client id means no draft seed, so rankedList returns the production rows

negative_controls.expectation: a missing model artifact yields the production ordering, deterministically
negative_controls.mechanism: validateModel returns null for an absent or malformed artifact and rankedList falls back

privacy.client_id: random 16 bytes from crypto.getRandomValues, base64url, generated in the browser, stored in localStorage with its creation time, rotated every 7 days. The server never derives, enriches or joins it.
privacy.consequence: Rotation caps how long any per-client analysis can reach back, and the interleaving credit is per client per day, which is well inside the window.

storage.decision: Cloudflare Workers Analytics Engine, binding EVENTS, dataset hacklist_events
storage.plan_basis: The Workers Free plan includes 100,000 data points written and 10,000 read queries per day, and datasets are created on first write with no dashboard or API provisioning step.
storage.provisioning: none; the binding is declared in wrangler.jsonc and takes effect on the next deploy
storage.no_resource_created_in_this_branch: Nothing was deployed and no Cloudflare resource was created while writing this. The binding is configuration only.
